title: Jobshop Employee Time Record / timesheet
summary: Legacy RTEC Jobshop employee timesheet template covering daily/weekly hours, training hours, leave categories and a multi-level signature/approval section. The file was last saved in April 2026 but its effective version period is not yet established.

claims.claim: The form records employee identity, dates, daily/weekly work hours, training hours, regular/overtime hours and multiple leave categories.
The form contains signature/approval lines for the employee, supervisor, Operations Manager and Executive Director.

evidence.note: Presence of signature lines does not prove the order or mandatory status of every approval in current practice.

trigger: Employee work/time period requiring a Jobshop Employee Time Record.
unresolved_questions: Is this Jobshop timesheet still actively used?
What pay-period cadence and submission deadline applies?
Which approval signatures are currently mandatory and in what order?
How are totals/formulas calculated in the legacy workbook?
Where are approved timesheets entered or retained downstream?
automation_candidates: Replace manual total calculations with validated formula-driven entry.
Route timesheets through explicit approval states while preserving required signatures/attestations.
Link training-hour entries to the training/recertification record when appropriate.

provenance.notes: Legacy XLS requires later formula/cell mapping if exact workbook reconstruction is needed.
